meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

copy.tagline: 管理 shadcn 组件和项目，添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 shadcn/ui 构建 React 界面，需要管理组件和项目配置
copy.tagline_en: Manage shadcn components and projects: add, search, fix, debug, and compose UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build React UIs with shadcn/ui and need to manage components and project config

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 可以管理 shadcn 组件和项目：添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI。它会自动获取项目配置，根据规则编写组件代码，并运行 CLI 命令安装或更新组件。
howto.when: 当用户讨论 shadcn/ui 组件、预设代码，或项目中存在 components.json 时触发。用户说“初始化 shadcn”、“用预设创建应用”或“切换预设”时也会触发。

say.text: 帮我添加一个 Button 组件到项目。
say.note: Claude 会运行 add 命令并安装组件。

say.text: 运行 shadcn 预设解码这个代码。
say.note: Claude 会使用 preset decode 命令。

say.text: 检查当前项目已安装的 shadcn 组件。
say.note: Claude 会查看项目配置并列出组件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage shadcn components and projects: adding, searching, fixing, debugging, and composing UI. It automatically obtains project config, writes component code following rules, and runs CLI commands to install or update components.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user discusses shadcn/ui components, preset codes, or the project has a components.json file. Also triggers for 'shadcn init', 'create an app with --preset', or 'switch to --preset'.

say_en.text: Add a Button component to the project.
say_en.note: Claude will run add and install the component.
Claude will use preset decode command.

say_en.text: List installed shadcn components in the current project.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect project config and list components.
